_comment: PROVISIONAL Stage 5 re-pointing of episode ground-truth from the old invented case ids to the real RCA library (data/kb/case_library.json) / hold-out set (data/kb/holdout.json). Mapped BY MECHANISM, never by which case scores better. Advisor must ratify this together with the hold-out split. `new` -> ground_truth.root_cause_id ; `actions` -> ground_truth.correct_action_ids (the mapped case's action set, from the same fixed catalogue; [] where the mechanism has no real case -> T2/T4/T6 all return applicable:false, NOT scored 0). `mapping`: library_exact | library_near | heldout_exact | heldout_approx | not_applicable.
old_scheme: 10 invented cases RCA-01, RCA-01b, RCA-02..RCA-09 (matched the pre-Stage-4 simulator by construction)

episodes.reason: FCV actuator stem seizure IS Case 1's physical root cause.
BFP suction loss from low deaerator level IS Case 16's root cause (cavitation from NPSH loss).

Feed strainer choke as a PRIMARY cause is not a standalone RCA case. Case 1 H2 / Case 16 aggravating contributor only. T2/T4/T6 not-applicable. (ACT-007 would be the mechanism-appropriate action if the advisor prefers to score it.)
Water wall tube erosion progressing to a longitudinal split IS Case 11's root cause.

CBD valve left open is Case 1's H3 contributory finding, not a standalone case. On the six tags its signature (water_balance SURPLUS + held level) is identical to RCA-11. T2/T4/T6 not-applicable. (ACT-021 would be the mechanism-appropriate action.)

Wet fines-heavy coal bridging -> intermittent feed -> outlet steam pressure sag at steady load IS Case 6's mechanism. RCA-06 is HELD OUT: generalisation test, T2/T4 measured over the scoreable subset.

Low-CV coal below the feeder calibration -> heat-input deficit -> pressure sag. Symptom family is Case 6; the low-CV pathway itself is Case 8 H2. Actions include ACT-018 (request coal lab report) which the wet-coal episodes do not need.
Loss of coal feeder(s). Case 14 (common-cause MCC single-phasing, all six) is the only feeder-loss case; this episode is a single feeder on overload. Same lost function, narrower cause.
High-CV coal fired without feeder recalibration IS Case 7's initiating change and a named root-cause contributor.

Low primary air RAISING bed temperature is Case 7's H2 contributory pathway, not a standalone case. Case 8 is the opposite polarity. Mapping to RCA-07 would score-game. T2/T4/T6 not-applicable. (ACT-019 would be the mechanism-appropriate action.)

Progressive heat-transfer-surface fouling has no standalone RCA case. Case 3 H4 is a ruled-out hypothesis; Case 13 is a different component. The regenerated episode's L1 signature also matches no case. T2/T4/T6 not-applicable. (ACT-024/ACT-025 would be the mechanism-appropriate actions.)
